fields.name: Ebb and Flow
fields.effect_text: Swap with an enemy minion in range; if it was adjacent to you, may repeat once.

fields.name: Stranger Tide
fields.effect_text: Place yourself into a space in range without a spawn point.

fields.name: Deluge
fields.effect_text: This turn: Enemy heroes in radius cannot fast travel, or move more than 1 space with a movement action.

fields.name: Master Duelist
fields.effect_text: Ignore all minion defense modifiers. This round: You are immune to attack actions of all enemy heroes, except this attacker.

fields.name: Violent Torrent
fields.effect_text: Target a unit adjacent to you. Before the attack: Up to 1 enemy hero in any of the 5 spaces in a straight line directly behind the target discards a card, or is defeated. May repeat once on a different unit.

fields.name: Tidal Blast
fields.effect_text: Target a unit in range. After the attack: You may push an enemy unit adjacent to you up to 3 spaces.

fields.name: Arcane Whirlpool
fields.effect_text: Swap with an enemy minion in range.

fields.name: Magical Current
fields.effect_text: Place yourself into a space in range without a spawn point and not adjacent to an empty spawn point.

fields.name: Expert Duelist
fields.effect_text: Ignore all minion defense modifiers. This turn: You are immune to attack actions of all enemy heroes, except this attacker.

fields.name: Slippery Ground
fields.effect_text: This turn: Enemy heroes adjacent to you cannot fast travel, or move more than 1 space with a movement action.

fields.name: Rogue Wave
fields.effect_text: Target a unit in range. After the attack: You may push an enemy unit adjacent to you up to 2 spaces.

fields.name: Raging Stream
fields.effect_text: Target a unit adjacent to you. Before the attack: Up to 1 enemy hero in any of the 3 spaces in a straight line directly behind the target discards a card, or is defeated.

fields.name: Spell Break
fields.effect_text: This turn: Enemy heroes in radius cannot perform skill actions, except on gold cards.

fields.name: Noble Blade
fields.effect_text: Target a unit adjacent to you. Before the attack: You may move another unit that is adjacent to the target 1 space.

fields.name: Aspiring Duelist
fields.effect_text: Ignore all minion defense modifiers.

fields.name: Dangerous Current
fields.effect_text: Target a unit adjacent to you. Before the attack: Up to 1 enemy hero in any of the 2 spaces in a straight line directly behind the target discards a card, or is defeated.

fields.name: Liquid Leap
fields.effect_text: Place yourself into a space in range without a spawn point and not adjacent to an empty spawn point.

fields.name: Living Tsunami
fields.effect_text: Once per turn, before performing an Attack action, you may move 1 space.

fields.name: Drop Trooper
fields.effect_text: Place yourself into a space in a straight line in radius. Push up to two enemy units adjacent to you up to 2 spaces.

fields.name: Mobile Scout
fields.effect_text: End of turn: Place yourself into a space in radius not in a straight line from you. You may then fast travel, if able.

fields.name: Killing Ground
fields.effect_text: An enemy hero in radius who is not adjacent to terrain discards a card, or is defeated.

fields.name: Hunting Season
fields.effect_text:
Move up to two enemy minions in radius, up to 3 spaces each, to spaces in radius.
Next turn: The first two times an enemy minion in radius is defeated, gain 1 coin.

fields.name: Killshot
fields.effect_text: Target a unit in range, in a straight line, and not adjacent to you.

fields.name: Super-Shotgun
fields.effect_text: Target a unit in range. Before the attack: An enemy hero adjacent to the target discards a card, or is defeated.

fields.name: Assault Jump
fields.effect_text: Place yourself into a space in a straight line in radius. Push an enemy unit adjacent to you up to 2 spaces.

fields.name: Delayed Jump
fields.effect_text: End of turn: Place yourself into a space in radius not in a straight line from you.

fields.name: Pin Down
fields.effect_text: An enemy hero in radius who is not adjacent to terrain discards a card, if able.

fields.name: Mark for Death
fields.effect_text:
Move an enemy minion in radius up to 3 spaces to a space in radius.
Next turn: The first time an enemy minion in radius is defeated, gain 1 coin.

fields.name: Prepared Shot
fields.effect_text: Target a unit in range, in a straight line, and not adjacent to you.

fields.name: Shotgun
fields.effect_text: Target a unit in range. Before the attack: An enemy hero adjacent to the target discards a card, if able.

fields.name: Steam Jump
fields.effect_text: Place yourself into a space in a straight line in radius. Push an enemy unit adjacent to you up to 1 space.

fields.name: Suppress
fields.effect_text: An enemy hero in radius who is not adjacent to terrain discards a card, if able.

fields.name: Snipe
fields.effect_text: Target a unit at maximum range, and in a straight line.

fields.name: Bounce
fields.effect_text: Move 2 spaces in a straight line, ignoring obstacles; if this card is already resolved as you perform this action, may repeat once.

fields.name: Reload!
fields.effect_text:
Choose one —
• Perform the primary action of your rightmost resolved card.
• Defeat a minion adjacent to you.

fields.name: Bullet Time
fields.effect_text: After you resolve a basic card, you may perform the primary action on that card; you cannot target the same enemy hero twice in the same turn this way.

fields.name: Avalanche
fields.effect_text:
You may move a unit in range 1 space to a space adjacent to terrain, or a :rock_token: Rock token.
May repeat once.

fields.name: Strolling Stone
fields.effect_text: Move any number of spaces in a straight line, ignoring obstacles, without moving through more than two empty spaces.

fields.name: Boulderdozer
fields.effect_text: Push a token, or an enemy unit, adjacent to you 1, 2, 3 or 4 spaces, ignoring obstacles; you may move up to 4 spaces in the direction of the push, ignoring obstacles.

fields.name: Ground Shaker
fields.effect_text:
Move a unit in radius which is adjacent to terrain, or to a :rock_token: Rock token, 1 space.
Place a Rock token in the space it occupied.
May repeat once on a different target.

fields.name: Epicenter
fields.effect_text:
An enemy hero in radius adjacent to terrain, or to a :rock_token: Rock token, discards a card, or is defeated.
May repeat once on a different target.

fields.name: Rock Solid
fields.effect_text:
You may retrieve a discarded card.
This round: If you would discard a card from your hand, you may discard this card instead; you may discard this card to perform its defense action, as if it was in your hand.

fields.name: Rockslide
fields.effect_text: You may move a unit in range 1 space to a space adjacent to terrain, or a :rock_token: Rock token.

fields.name: Rolling Stone
fields.effect_text:
Move any number of spaces in a straight line, ignoring obstacles, without moving through more than one empty space.
( The starting space and the destination space do not count. )

fields.name: Boulder Blitz
fields.effect_text: Push a token, or an enemy unit, adjacent to you 1, 2 or 3 spaces, ignoring obstacles; you may move up to 3 spaces in the direction of the push, ignoring obstacles.

fields.name: Stomping Step
fields.effect_text:
Move a unit in radius which is adjacent to terrain, or to a :rock_token: Rock token, 1 space.
Place a Rock token in the space it occupied.

fields.name: Seismic Assault
fields.effect_text: An enemy hero in radius adjacent to terrain, or to a :rock_token: Rock token, discards a card, or is defeated.

fields.name: Stone Carapace
fields.effect_text: This round: If you would discard a card from your hand, you may discard this card instead; you may discard this card to perform its defense action, as if it was in your hand.

fields.name: Treacherous Ground
fields.effect_text: You may move a unit in range 1 space to a space adjacent to terrain, or a :rock_token: Rock token.

fields.name: Boulder Rush
fields.effect_text: Push a token, or an enemy unit, adjacent to you 1 or 2 spaces, ignoring obstacles; you may move up to 2 spaces in the direction of the push, ignoring obstacles.

fields.name: Seismic Slam
fields.effect_text:
An enemy hero in radius adjacent to terrain, or to a :rock_token: Rock token, discards a card, or is defeated.
( The :attack: secondary Attack action is non-ranged. )

fields.name: Stone Grip
fields.effect_text: Place exactly 3 :rock_token: Rock tokens into empty spaces adjacent to an enemy hero in range, and as far away from you as possible.

fields.name: Fissure
fields.effect_text: Target a unit adjacent to you. After the attack: Place a :rock_token: Rock token in each of the first three empty spaces in the straight line from you in the direction of the attack.

fields.name: Rock and a Hard Place
fields.effect_text: Once per turn, after you place one or more :rock_token: Rock tokens into one or more spaces adjacent to one or more enemy heroes, each of those heroes discards a card, if able.

fields.name: Throwing Spear
fields.effect_text:
Choose one —
• Target a unit adjacent to you.
• You may discard a card. If you have a card in the discard, target a unit in range.

fields.name: Furious Charge
fields.effect_text: Before the attack: Move 2, 3, or 4 spaces in a straight line to a space adjacent to an enemy unit, then target that unit.

fields.name: Master Skald
fields.effect_text: A friendly hero in range gains 2 coins; if any hero was defeated this round, that friendly hero gains 4 coins instead.

fields.name: Fortify
fields.effect_text: This round: When any friendly minion in radius is defeated you may discard a basic card. If you do, the minion is not removed.

fields.name: Counterattack
fields.effect_text: An enemy hero adjacent to you who has played an attack card this turn discards a card, or is defeated.

fields.name: Savage Kick
fields.effect_text: Move up to 2 spaces. Push an enemy unit or a token adjacent to you up to 2 spaces.

fields.name: War Drummer

fields.name: Bolster
fields.effect_text: This round: When any friendly minion in radius is defeated you may discard a silver card. If you do, the minion is not removed.

fields.name: Shield Bash

fields.name: Onslaught
fields.effect_text: Target a unit adjacent to you. After the attack: Move into the space it occupied, if able.

An enemy hero in radius adjacent to terrain, or to a :rock_token: Rock token, discards a card, or is defeated.
May repeat once on a different target.

deck.name: Ebb and Flow
deck.effect_text: Swap with an enemy minion in range; if it was adjacent to you, may repeat once.

deck.name: Stranger Tide
deck.effect_text: Place yourself into a space in range without a spawn point.

deck.name: Deluge
deck.effect_text: This turn: Enemy heroes in radius cannot fast travel, or move more than 1 space with a movement action.

deck.name: Master Duelist
deck.effect_text: Ignore all minion defense modifiers. This round: You are immune to attack actions of all enemy heroes, except this attacker.

deck.name: Violent Torrent
deck.effect_text: Target a unit adjacent to you. Before the attack: Up to 1 enemy hero in any of the 5 spaces in a straight line directly behind the target discards a card, or is defeated. May repeat once on a different unit.

deck.name: Tidal Blast
deck.effect_text: Target a unit in range. After the attack: You may push an enemy unit adjacent to you up to 3 spaces.

deck.name: Arcane Whirlpool
deck.effect_text: Swap with an enemy minion in range.

deck.name: Magical Current
deck.effect_text: Place yourself into a space in range without a spawn point and not adjacent to an empty spawn point.

deck.name: Expert Duelist
deck.effect_text: Ignore all minion defense modifiers. This turn: You are immune to attack actions of all enemy heroes, except this attacker.

deck.name: Slippery Ground
deck.effect_text: This turn: Enemy heroes adjacent to you cannot fast travel, or move more than 1 space with a movement action.

deck.name: Rogue Wave
deck.effect_text: Target a unit in range. After the attack: You may push an enemy unit adjacent to you up to 2 spaces.

deck.name: Raging Stream
deck.effect_text: Target a unit adjacent to you. Before the attack: Up to 1 enemy hero in any of the 3 spaces in a straight line directly behind the target discards a card, or is defeated.

deck.name: Spell Break
deck.effect_text: This turn: Enemy heroes in radius cannot perform skill actions, except on gold cards.

deck.name: Noble Blade
deck.effect_text: Target a unit adjacent to you. Before the attack: You may move another unit that is adjacent to the target 1 space.

deck.name: Aspiring Duelist
deck.effect_text: Ignore all minion defense modifiers.

deck.name: Dangerous Current
deck.effect_text: Target a unit adjacent to you. Before the attack: Up to 1 enemy hero in any of the 2 spaces in a straight line directly behind the target discards a card, or is defeated.

deck.name: Liquid Leap
deck.effect_text: Place yourself into a space in range without a spawn point and not adjacent to an empty spawn point.

ultimate_card.name: Living Tsunami

deck.name: Drop Trooper
deck.effect_text: Place yourself into a space in a straight line in radius. Push up to two enemy units adjacent to you up to 2 spaces.

deck.name: Mobile Scout
deck.effect_text: End of turn: Place yourself into a space in radius not in a straight line from you. You may then fast travel, if able.

deck.name: Killing Ground
deck.effect_text: An enemy hero in radius who is not adjacent to terrain discards a card, or is defeated.

deck.name: Hunting Season
deck.effect_text:
Move up to two enemy minions in radius, up to 3 spaces each, to spaces in radius.
Next turn: The first two times an enemy minion in radius is defeated, gain 1 coin.

deck.name: Killshot
deck.effect_text: Target a unit in range, in a straight line, and not adjacent to you.

deck.name: Super-Shotgun
deck.effect_text: Target a unit in range. Before the attack: An enemy hero adjacent to the target discards a card, or is defeated.

deck.name: Assault Jump
deck.effect_text: Place yourself into a space in a straight line in radius. Push an enemy unit adjacent to you up to 2 spaces.

deck.name: Delayed Jump
deck.effect_text: End of turn: Place yourself into a space in radius not in a straight line from you.

deck.name: Pin Down
deck.effect_text: An enemy hero in radius who is not adjacent to terrain discards a card, if able.

deck.name: Mark for Death
deck.effect_text:
Move an enemy minion in radius up to 3 spaces to a space in radius.
Next turn: The first time an enemy minion in radius is defeated, gain 1 coin.

deck.name: Prepared Shot
deck.effect_text: Target a unit in range, in a straight line, and not adjacent to you.

deck.name: Shotgun
deck.effect_text: Target a unit in range. Before the attack: An enemy hero adjacent to the target discards a card, if able.

deck.name: Steam Jump
deck.effect_text: Place yourself into a space in a straight line in radius. Push an enemy unit adjacent to you up to 1 space.

deck.name: Suppress

deck.name: Snipe
deck.effect_text: Target a unit at maximum range, and in a straight line.

deck.name: Bounce

deck.effect_text:

• Defeat a minion adjacent to you.

deck.name: Avalanche
deck.effect_text:
You may move a unit in range 1 space to a space adjacent to terrain, or a :rock_token: Rock token.
May repeat once.

deck.name: Strolling Stone
deck.effect_text: Move any number of spaces in a straight line, ignoring obstacles, without moving through more than two empty spaces.

deck.name: Boulderdozer
deck.effect_text: Push a token, or an enemy unit, adjacent to you 1, 2, 3 or 4 spaces, ignoring obstacles; you may move up to 4 spaces in the direction of the push, ignoring obstacles.

deck.name: Ground Shaker
deck.effect_text:
Move a unit in radius which is adjacent to terrain, or to a :rock_token: Rock token, 1 space.
Place a Rock token in the space it occupied.
May repeat once on a different target.

deck.name: Rockslide
